candidates.place_reason: 306e audit 2026-10-13: similarity (8 pts, resid 6.0-35.6 m, 0.72 m/px, -0.1 deg). The 8 anchors are a 199-200 m per 100 px grid, so the fit carries no placement information (the bury-castle class). The site point inverse-maps to the plate's 'Newgate'/'Head Lands' ground west of the town centre (open hatched fields); the plate's own Market Place lands ~310 m SSE of the real market and its drawn castle (feature 17) ~520 m SSE of the real moated castle, south of the River Calder, where the 1842 and LiDAR show fields and no castle; the plate's main street crosses over the real castle. Wrong place, right kind. Document deleted.
